Formatting
* Please study the formatting syntax described on this page: https://www.codingame.com/playgrounds/40701/help-center/statement , and format your statement properly as described in the points below.

Stub generator
* Please add a write statement, e.g. write answer.

Input
* Please format "Line 1", "Line 2", etc. in <<bold>>.

* Please format A, B, C and D as [[variables]].

* Please remove "random" from all the descriptions.

Output
* Please format the line numbers in <<bold>>.

* Some line numbers are incorrect.

Constraints
* Please format A, B, C and D as [[variables]].

Cases
* Each test and validator should cover the same scenario, using different inputs and outputs. Currently, the cases don't seem to target specific scenarios. Please revise them as follows:

  • Test/Validator 1: A, B, C and D are all distinct, with A being the largest.

  • Test/Validator 2: A, B, C and D are all distinct, with B being the largest.

  • Test/Validator 3: A, B, C and D are all distinct, with C being the largest.

  • Test/Validator 4: A, B, C and D are all distinct, with D being the largest.

  • Test/Validator 5: Two of the four integers are equal.

  • Test/Validator 6: Three of the four integers are equal.

  • Test/Validator 7: All four integers are equal.

* Please also use more random integers as inputs; there are currently too many single-digit integers.

Thanks.
